clips.title: The story
paras: Wizlo Bearingshiner is a goblin tinkerer stranded at Whitereach Post in Thousand Needles. The sole survivor of a centaur attack on his caravan, he recruits travelers to recover a valuable Hypercapacitor Gizmo from the wreckage.

Staying alongside the tauren at Whitereach Post along the canyon road, Wizlo Bearingshiner faces an unwelcome delay. Centaur attacked his caravan, leaving him as its only survivor. His clients are waiting for their wares, and he worries that he will not deliver them in time.

Wizlo's best gizmo hangs around the neck of a fierce panther caged beside his ruined caravan north of Whitereach Post. Even the centaur avoid the beast. Wizlo offers travelers the cage key and a reward for recovering the hypercapacitor, though he admits he has yet to work out what the device actually does.
